# TaxPro Florida

> Educational guides to Florida taxes: no state personal income tax and residency, homestead exemption and Save Our Homes, sales tax basics, corporate income and reemployment tax, and choosing a CPA, EA or tax attorney. Not a tax firm; not tax advice.

All content is general education, not tax or legal advice. TaxPro Florida does not prepare returns or offer professional services.

## Pages

- [Home](https://taxproflorida.com/): Overview of TaxPro Florida's educational tax guides with key facts and FAQs.
- [Florida Has No State Income Tax: What It Covers and What It Doesn't](https://taxproflorida.com/florida-no-state-income-tax): What Florida's lack of a personal income tax means, the taxes residents still pay, and how to establish domicile.
- [Florida Homestead Exemption and Save Our Homes, Explained](https://taxproflorida.com/florida-homestead-exemption): Who qualifies, the March 1 deadline, how the Save Our Homes cap and portability work, and other exemptions.
- [Florida Sales Tax Guide: Rates, Exemptions and Business Basics](https://taxproflorida.com/florida-sales-tax-guide): The 6% state rate plus county surtax, what's exempt, use tax, and how businesses register, collect and file.
- [Florida Business Taxes: Corporate Income Tax, Reemployment Tax and More](https://taxproflorida.com/florida-business-taxes): Corporate income tax, reemployment (unemployment) tax, tangible personal property tax, local business taxes and annual reports.
- [How to Choose a Tax Professional in Florida: CPA vs. EA vs. Tax Attorney](https://taxproflorida.com/choosing-a-tax-professional): The differences between CPAs, enrolled agents and tax attorneys, how to verify credentials, red flags and free help.
- [About](https://taxproflorida.com/about): Who runs TaxPro Florida, its educational mission and its not-a-tax-firm disclaimer.
- [Contact](https://taxproflorida.com/contact): How to reach TaxPro Florida by email.
- [Privacy Policy](https://taxproflorida.com/privacy): What data the site collects and how it is used.
